title: mmt-plugin build --json result, schema_version 1
description: The result of build (docs/design/cli.md, section 6). Paths are relative to the project when inside it (POSIX separators), absolute otherwise. stages are always the four, in order; a stage the run did not reach is skipped. commands are the compiler command lines run (or, with --dry-run, that would run), in order; empty when the build is up to date.

profile.description: The SDK profile the plugin is generated for.

status.description: stale: generate with --no-deps, when the generated files are not up to date.

artifact.description: The plugin, when it exists after the run (built, or up to date); null on a failure or a dry run that would build.

cflags.description: The compile flags, fixed in code (the profile's -std first).

ldflags.description: The link flags, fixed in code.

up_to_date.description: The inputs hash to the last build's and the plugin is that build's: nothing ran.
